description: A row of a list (DESIGN.md, List, ListItem, Section): a pressable row when onPressed is set, a plain row otherwise, with an optional leading icon, avatar or thumbnail, a title and subtitle, and trailing (a value or a control) — a chevron by default when the row navigates and nothing else trails. current bolds the title (weight 800) and marks it as the current item; destructive puts the title in TsuyaColors.danger (keep it alone in the last group); tall grows the row for an account row.

params.name: title
params.description: The row's title, one line (ellipsized if it must).

params.name: subtitle
params.description: Below the title, one line, muted.

params.name: onPressed
params.description: Called on a press; makes the row pressable (fill on hover, fill-strong on press). Null for a plain row.

params.name: navigates
params.description: Whether the row opens another screen: the default trailing chevron, when nothing else trails it.

params.name: tall
params.description: Grows the row to TsuyaSize.rowTall, for an account row.

params.name: current
params.description: The current item: a bold (800) title and a marker.

params.name: destructive
params.description: Puts the title in TsuyaColors.danger; keep it alone in the last group.

params.name: selected
params.description: In a selectable list, whether this is the chosen row: a tick at the end. Null outside a selectable list.

params.name: leading
params.description: An icon 20, an avatar 40, or a thumbnail 40 to 48.

params.name: trailing
params.description: A value or a control; a chevron shows by default when navigates and this is null.
